product_summary: Website fabflavours.com (About us + Products pages) shows a flavour house, not a pharma formulator. Real product lines: (1) water-soluble flavours, (2) oil-soluble flavours (regular 2010, premium 2016), (3) encapsulated powder flavours 'Fab Cap' for chewable tablets, dry syrups, chewing gums, protein supplements, (4) 100% natural extracts and natural flavours (launched 2018), (5) RC / Red Club soft-drink concentrates and beverage emulsions (since 1965), (6) retail bottled flavours (Blue Bell by Fab, Premium ranges), (7) Evaporex non-alcoholic edible-colour painting/airbrush medium (2017), (8) Naimaaroma aromatics/essential oils. Catalogue lists 200+ named flavour SKUs (vanilla, mango, pani puri, paan beeda, kulfi, biryani, whiskey/rum/beer-type flavours, cheese, etc.). Address on site: 14/18 Nangli Sakrawati Extension, New Delhi-110043. No customs line, invoice or shipping document was reviewed in this task, so all of the above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — it is corroborated only by the company's own website, not by a customs record.
role_hint: manufacturer (site states own manufacturing since 1965 under Red Club brand and Fab Flavours & Fragrance P. Ltd from 1993; ISO 22000 and FSSAI claimed). Historical trader origin (Sher-I-Punjab trading house 1919/1950) — so manufacturer with trader heritage; no independent evidence of manufacturing plant reviewed.
comment: HS 300490 (medicaments, retail packs) does not match the actual product range. The company makes food/beverage flavouring compounds and natural extracts; the correct primary code is 3302.10 (mixtures of odoriferous substances for the food and drink industries), with 1302.19 for the natural extract range, 2106.90 for Evaporex and retail flavour preparations, and 3301 for the aromatics/essential-oil line. 300490 could only apply to a narrow pharma-flavouring sub-line (Fab Cap encapsulated flavours are marketed to pharma/nutraceutical clients), and even there the goods are flavour compounds supplied as raw material, not finished medicaments — so 300490 is a wrong classification, not merely partial. Per project rule 3 the company is NOT rejected on HS grounds: it stays in the base and the code is corrected to 3302.10 (with 1302.19 / 2106.90 / 3301 as secondary lines); verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' is a misclassification of the sector — this is food ingredients / flavour & fragrance manufacturing (FMCG-adjacent specialty chemicals), not oil & gas. Trader signs: the company itself describes a 1919/1950 trading-house origin and 30 years of reselling IFF/Bush Boake Allen, L&T and Roha Dye Chem products before manufacturing — so a trading/distribution component exists alongside manufacturing. Product lines missing from the declaration: natural botanical extracts (1302.19), essential oils/aromatics (3301), soft-drink concentrates and beverage emulsions (typically 2106.90 / 3302.10), and the Evaporex edible-colour medium (2106.90 or 3212/3204 depending on composition). All product facts are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — sourced only from fabflavours.com (About us, Products); no customs line, B-L or invoice was available in this task, and no registry/revenue/customs-volume research was performed per role scope.
